query_sql:
SELECT `transport_mode` AS transport_mode,COUNT(*) AS total_trips,
      COUNT(DISTINCT `trip_id`) AS unique_trip_ids,
      SUM(`trip_distance_km`) AS total_km,SUM(`lumina_total_fare_usd`) AS total_revenue_usd,
      SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(`lumina_total_fare_usd`),SUM(`trip_distance_km`)) AS revenue_per_km_usd,
      AVG(`lumina_duration_min`) AS avg_duration_min,AVG(`passenger_count`) AS avg_passengers,
      CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS traffic_matched_trips,CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS iot_matched_trips,
      COUNTIF(`trip_distance_km` IS NULL) AS missing_distance_rows,
      COUNTIF(`lumina_total_fare_usd` IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
      COUNTIF(`trip_distance_km` < 0) AS negative_distance_rows
    FROM `bigdata-herles-pinedo.lumina_gold_governed.fact_movilidad_multimodal_gold` GROUP BY transport_mode ORDER BY transport_mode
limitation: Se usan los registros ya existentes; no se certifica su procedencia externa por el solo hecho de estar en BigQuery.

SELECT travel_date, county_name, transport_mode, hod,
      COUNT(*) AS total_trips, SUM(trip_distance_km) AS total_km,
      SUM(lumina_total_fare_usd) AS total_revenue_usd,
      SUM(lumina_duration_min) AS duration_sum, COUNT(lumina_duration_min) AS duration_count,
      SUM(passenger_count) AS passengers_sum, COUNT(passenger_count) AS passengers_count,
      COUNTIF(trip_distance_km IS NULL) AS missing_distance_rows,
      COUNTIF(lumina_total_fare_usd IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
      COUNTIF(trip_distance_km < 0) AS negative_distance_rows
    FROM `bigdata-herles-pinedo.lumina_gold_governed.fact_movilidad_multimodal_gold` GROUP BY travel_date, county_name, transport_mode, hod
    ORDER BY travel_date, county_name, transport_mode, hod
